inputs.text: Calling this “chaos” obscures what happened: a huge “No Kings” protest was met with tear gas and arrests by federal officers, with at least 13 arrests confirmed in Portland and Denver. Branding demonstrators “agitators” is a familiar way to delegitimize dissent and shield state power from scrutiny. When people protesting face intimidation and arrest while the state commands force, that is a serious threat to democratic rights. Protecting those rights means safeguarding protest, not suppressing it.
